messages:
Priya (DevEx): FYI linkcheck started failing on the nightly run. Broken fragment: /sdk/python#install-and-get-started-flags
CI-Bot: LINKCHECK: Broken fragment -> /sdk/python#install-and-get-started-flags (404)
Sam (Docs): looks like that heading was changed during the SDK snippet tidy: current heading in sdk/python.md is `## Install & get started 🚩`
Ivy (SDK): ah yeah I removed some punctuation in the heading but didn't add an explicit id. the emoji likely changed the slug during the markdown parser bump. older inbound links used #install-and-get-started-flags
Luis (Eng): reproducible locally: slugifier now drops emoji entirely and collapses '&' -> 'and' in our build, but CI uses a slightly different slug implementation which collapses differently. this produces inconsistent fragments across environments
Sam (Docs): plan: short-term patch to add an explicit id to the heading and update the SDK quickstart snippet that links to it. mid-term: add a small canonicalization step in linkcheck CI to consult our redirects mapping
Ivy (SDK): I'll open a tiny PR that: 1) adds an explicit id to the heading, 2) updates the quickstart snippet's internal link to point to the explicit id, 3) updates mkdocs.yml redirects to preserve the legacy fragment. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/9001 (WIP)
Ivy (SDK): heading patch I'm about to push:
```md
## Install & get started 🚩 {#install-and-get-started-flags}
```
Ivy (SDK): quickstart snippet that linked to it had: `[see flags](#install-and-get-started-flags)` so i'll update those internal anchors to the explicit id
Luis (Eng): redirect entry (mkdocs-redirects) to cover external bookmarks:
```yaml
plugins:
  - redirects:
      redirects:
        'sdk/python/#install-and-get-started-flags': 'sdk/python/#install-and-get-started-flags'
```
Sam (Docs): tiny nit: can we avoid adding emoji to public headings going forward? emoji in headings cause slug churn. add a note to docs/contrib/heading-style.md recommending explicit ids for any heading we link to externally
Priya (DevEx): agreed. I will also add a temporary exception list in linkcheck that accepts redirects defined in mkdocs.yml so CI won't noise while PRs roll out. we'll make it warning-only for 48 hours then stricter
CI-Bot: PR 9001 | checks started
Ivy (SDK): updated PR with explanation about slugifier changes and added a short migration note in docs/migration/slug-behavior.md describing emoji and punctuation caveats
Luis (Eng): LGTM on changes. after CI passes we should run a grep across the repo for headings containing emoji, '&', ':' and backticks to prioritize explicit ids for externally referenced pages
Sam (Docs): i'll run that audit and open small follow-ups for the ones I own. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
